decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own page and close to the established offer, it most likely meets aspiration, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric serves the contract and hospitality projects the firm targets and keeps its own page, which indicates performance at or above aspiration.

The wool bouclé leno fits the sustainability direction but is only mentioned rather than featured, and it resembles the withdrawn semi-transparent bouclé and wool-blend items, so the risk is elevated yet the evidence does not show a clear shortfall.

A newly launched braided fabric with its own page needs time for its results to show, and the firm's slack in a growing industry allows it to carry the product while its performance is still uncertain.
